turns.content: For a disubstituted aromatic six-membered ring with two aromatic-proton signals, identify the C6H4 ring contribution and the symmetry implied by the spectrum.
Use the first spectroscopic assignment and signal pattern established above to infer the simplest first ring-attached fragment and its composition contribution.
Use the second splitting pattern and remaining signal established above to infer the other substituent and its composition contribution.
Combine the aromatic scaffold with the two fragments identified spectroscopically to derive the molecular formula.
Show the component counts implied by that derived composition.
State the resulting composition at the evidential confidence established above.
Check its internal consistency with the structural and spectral features retained above and compute the corresponding degree of unsaturation.
Report the molecular formula and summarize how the two spectroscopic fragments support it.
